signal: Loop raised a $95M Series C led by Valor to scale its AI supply chain platform across more enterprise use cases.

email.body1:
Eric, saw Loop just closed a $95M Series C to push the AI platform across more enterprise use cases.

That kind of expansion floods the SDR team with more accounts and inbound than reps can follow up on while they are still ramping, and speed-to-lead slips. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of Loop's top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.subject2: your outbound, 3 things I would change
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up for Loop.

When the account list grows post-raise, the bottleneck is rarely strategy, it is follow-up volume and response speed across a team that is still ramping. That is exactly where most reply rate is left on the table.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of Loop's current outbound, three things I would change. Our best-practice patterns alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for Loop.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Loop's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Eric, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting follow-up load and ramp time is not a priority for the team this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling an SDR org right after a raise is plenty to juggle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Loop either way.
